title: Vouchers at checkout
body:
Adds **vouchers** to accounts: a `Voucher` row per payment, recorded before the total refresh so the account total includes it.

Read the controller first, then the service.
author: claude

body: New service. Validates the amount and writes one `Voucher` row in the caller's unit of work.
author: claude

body: Formatting only, apart from the new `amount` validator.
author: claude

body: Order matters: the voucher is recorded before `RefreshTotal`.
author: claude

title: Old total
body: The old total ignored vouchers entirely.
author: claude
